title: Campaign Readiness Check
subtitle: Before We Continue
heading: ## Unit 10 ·

parts.scope: The Readiness Check intro (Mar'tu: "You have learned enough to help, yes? Show me without the hints. Then we continue."), Part 1 form A (the 13 unaided items of curriculum §5.3), mini-boss A "Hold the Lantern Ward" (§5.4, campaign mode for everyone), and the one-click "Explain a line you wrote" item rc-explain (§5.2). Read ALL of curriculum §5 ("Campaign Readiness Check") before writing.
Part 1 form B (the same 13 skills as form A with new numbers, names and situations, per §5) and mini-boss B (§5.4). Read ALL of curriculum §5 before writing; match form A's skill tags item for item.

Part 1 form C (same 13 skills, third variant) and the spaced re-check items rc-recheck (testout, §5.2: unaided, before Module 2 or about a week later), plus the review routing per missed skill into the earlier units' items (§5.2 'Review routing'), as far as the current schema supports it. Read ALL of curriculum §5 before writing.

slips: the campaign-critical slips the whole course has targeted: typing literal values instead of reading/handing over (CMB), print instead of return, = vs ==, > vs >= at the exact boundary, unquoted text and quoted names (KEY), a missing colon or indent, def vs =, calling a function vs handing it over without (), skipping a nesting level in a sheet, str() before +, parentheses in "░" * (10 - 3), resetting a total inside a loop, approximate parameter names, editing a helper you were told to leave alone.
earlierNote: Units 1-4 are in the repo (copied here). Units 5 (Dictionaries), 6 (Loops) and 7 (Functions II) are verified in staging and copied here. Units 8 (optional challenges) and 9 (Strings) are NOT needed: the Readiness Check must use NO Strings (Unit 9) token — the READY gate path proves it; run the harness and confirm no u09 token appears.
verifyNote: Fix every Unit 10 error until 0 errors (all prerequisite units' real files are in this folder, so run with concept_map.json moved aside first). Confirm the READY path: no token that the concept map gives to u09a/u09b/u09c appears anywhere in Unit 10. Report the Part 1 and mini-boss time totals against the curriculum (~28 min Part 1, ~15 min mini-boss).
extra: This unit is a CHECK, not a lesson: Part 1 is unaided (no hints, tracer, Another way or Assemble it; glossary, read-aloud and the explainer stay on; code answers typed; every typed item rechecked with other values). Part 2 is campaign mode for everyone (§2.10: numbered comments, check messages, the explainer, Compare after 5 minutes, hints capped at rung 2, no Assemble it). Represent these with the schema's existing fields (support="none"/"light", explainer="lean", testout/quiz kinds, questions_to_pass) — read FORMAT.md; never invent fields, and list in your report what site support (e.g. a hint cap, a Compare timer, skill-tag routing) is missing. Every Part 1 item lists its skill tags and the campaign part it prepares, per §5.3. Our world, never the campaign's exact code. Honest tracing: no Assemble, no answer in any visible text, paste_stop on trace items. Lean check messages name the slip and the evidence, never the fix. Never use worksheet-derived names or "Tester" in check data; invented Tor names only.
